question: 三星1月的销售额是多少？
reference_sql: SELECT SUM(fo.order_amount) AS sales_amount FROM fact_order fo JOIN dim_product dp ON fo.product_id = dp.product_id JOIN dim_date dd ON fo.date_id = dd.date_id WHERE dp.brand = '三星' AND dd.month = 1;

GROUP BY r.province
ORDER BY total_quantity DESC
LIMIT 5;

FROM fact_order fo

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT fo.order_id) AS order_count
FROM fact_order fo
JOIN dim_region dr ON fo.region_id = dr.region_id
JOIN dim_product dp ON fo.product_id = dp.product_id

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS order_count FROM fact_order o JOIN dim_product p ON o.product_id = p.product_id JOIN dim_region r ON o.region_id = r.region_id WHERE r.region_name = '华北' AND p.category = '休闲零食';

question: 销售额最高的月份是哪个月？
reference_sql:
SELECT d.month AS month, SUM(f.order_amount) AS sales_amount
FROM fact_order f
JOIN dim_date d ON f.date_id = d.date_id
GROUP BY d.month
ORDER BY sales_amount DESC
LIMIT 1;

question: 华南的休闲零食有多少订单？
reference_sql:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT fo.order_id) AS order_count
FROM fact_order fo
JOIN dim_product dp ON fo.product_id = dp.product_id
JOIN dim_region dr ON fo.region_id = dr.region_id
WHERE dr.region_name = '华南'
  AND dp.category = '休闲零食';

question: 四川省的休闲零食销售额是多少？
reference_sql:
SELECT SUM(f.order_amount) AS sales_amount
FROM fact_order f
JOIN dim_region r ON f.region_id = r.region_id
JOIN dim_product p ON f.product_id = p.product_id
WHERE r.province = '四川省'
  AND p.category = '休闲零食';

【用户查询】
各大区各品类的销售额分别是多少？

SELECT r.region_name AS region_name, p.category AS category, SUM(f.order_amount) AS sales_amount
FROM fact_order f
JOIN dim_product p ON f.product_id = p.product_id
JOIN dim_region r ON f.region_id = r.region_id
GROUP BY r.region_name, p.category
ORDER BY r.region_name, p.category;

question: 按性别统计销售额
reference_sql: SELECT c.gender, SUM(o.order_amount) AS sales_amount FROM fact_order o JOIN dim_customer c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY c.gender;

question: 哪个产品值得重点推

SELECT p.product_id, p.product_name, SUM(o.order_amount) AS gmv, SUM(o.order_quantity) AS total_quantity, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS order_count

LIMIT 1;

question: 各品牌的销售额排名是怎样的？
reference_sql:
SELECT p.brand AS brand, SUM(o.order_amount) AS sales_amount, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(o.order_amount) DESC) AS sales_rank

JOIN dim_product p ON o.product_id = p.product_id
GROUP BY p.brand
ORDER BY sales_rank;

各品牌的销售额排名是怎样的？

SELECT p.brand AS brand, SUM(o.order_amount) AS sales_amount, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(o.order_amount) DESC) AS sales_rank
FROM fact_order o
JOIN dim_product p ON o.product_id = p.product_id
GROUP BY p.brand
ORDER BY sales_rank;

question: 华南大区服饰的销售额是多少？
reference_sql:
SELECT SUM(fo.order_amount) AS sales_amount
FROM fact_order fo
JOIN dim_product dp ON fo.product_id = dp.product_id
JOIN dim_region dr ON fo.region_id = dr.region_id
WHERE dr.region_name = '华南'
  AND dp.category = '服饰';

WHERE dc.member_level = '白银';

reference_sql:
WITH recent_period AS (
  SELECT
    SUM(order_amount) AS gmv,
    COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS order_cnt,
    SUM(order_quantity) AS qty,
    AVG(order_amount) AS aov
  FROM fact_order
  WHERE date_id BETWEEN 20260913 AND 20260919
),
previous_period AS (
  SELECT
    SUM(order_amount) AS gmv,
    COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS order_cnt,
    SUM(order_quantity) AS qty,
    AVG(order_amount) AS aov
  FROM fact_order
  WHERE date_id BETWEEN 20260906 AND 20260912
)
SELECT
  r.gmv AS recent_7d_gmv,
  p.gmv AS previous_7d_gmv,
  ROUND((r.gmv - p.gmv) / NULLIF(p.gmv, 0) * 100, 2) AS gmv_growth_pct,
  r.order_cnt AS recent_7d_order_count,
  p.order_cnt AS previous_7d_order_count,
  ROUND((r.order_cnt - p.order_cnt) / NULLIF(p.order_cnt, 0) * 100, 2) AS order_count_growth_pct,
  r.aov AS recent_7d_aov,
  p.aov AS previous_7d_aov,
  ROUND((r.aov - p.aov) / NULLIF(p.aov, 0) * 100, 2) AS aov_growth_pct,
  r.qty AS recent_7d_quantity,
  p.qty AS previous_7d_quantity
FROM recent_period r
CROSS JOIN previous_period p;

WITH recent_period AS (
  SELECT
    SUM(order_amount) AS gmv,
    COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS order_cnt,
    SUM(order_quantity) AS qty,
    AVG(order_amount) AS aov
  FROM fact_order
  WHERE date_id BETWEEN 20260913 AND 20260919
),
previous_period AS (
  SELECT
    SUM(order_amount) AS gmv,
    COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS order_cnt,
    SUM(order_quantity) AS qty,
    AVG(order_amount) AS aov
  FROM fact_order
  WHERE date_id BETWEEN 20260906 AND 20260912
)
SELECT
  r.gmv AS recent_7d_gmv,
  p.gmv AS previous_7d_gmv,
  ROUND((r.gmv - p.gmv) / NULLIF(p.gmv, 0) * 100, 2) AS gmv_growth_pct,
  r.order_cnt AS recent_7d_order_count,
  p.order_cnt AS previous_7d_order_count,
  ROUND((r.order_cnt - p.order_cnt) / NULLIF(p.order_cnt, 0) * 100, 2) AS order_count_growth_pct,
  r.aov AS recent_7d_aov,
  p.aov AS previous_7d_aov,
  ROUND((r.aov - p.aov) / NULLIF(p.aov, 0) * 100, 2) AS aov_growth_pct,
  r.qty AS recent_7d_quantity,
  p.qty AS previous_7d_quantity
FROM recent_period r
CROSS JOIN previous_period p;

question: 各省份的销售额排名是怎样的？

SELECT r.province AS province,
       SUM(o.order_amount) AS sales_amount,
       RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(o.order_amount) DESC) AS sales_rank
FROM fact_order AS o
JOIN dim_region AS r ON o.region_id = r.region_id
GROUP BY r.province
ORDER BY sales_amount DESC;

【用户查询】
耐克 Air Max 270 运动鞋的订单数是多少？

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS order_count
FROM fact_order o
JOIN dim_product p ON o.product_id = p.product_id
WHERE (p.brand LIKE '%耐克%' OR p.brand LIKE '%Nike%')
  AND p.product_name LIKE '%Air Max 270%';

question: Apple这个品牌贡献了多少销售额？
reference_sql:
SELECT SUM(fo.order_amount) AS sales_amount
FROM fact_order fo
JOIN dim_product dp ON fo.product_id = dp.product_id
WHERE dp.brand IN ('Apple', '苹果');

销售额最高的前10个商品是哪些？

SELECT p.product_id, p.product_name, SUM(o.order_amount) AS sales_amount
FROM fact_order o
JOIN dim_product p ON o.product_id = p.product_id
GROUP BY p.product_id, p.product_name
ORDER BY sales_amount DESC
LIMIT 10;

question: 销售额最高的前5个大区是哪些？
reference_sql:
SELECT d.region_name AS 大区, SUM(f.order_amount) AS 销售额
FROM fact_order f
JOIN dim_region d ON f.region_id = d.region_id
GROUP BY d.region_name
ORDER BY 销售额 DESC
LIMIT 5;

销售额排名第一的品牌是哪个？

SELECT p.brand, SUM(o.order_amount) AS sales_amount
FROM fact_order o
JOIN dim_product p ON o.product_id = p.product_id
GROUP BY p.brand
ORDER BY sales_amount DESC
LIMIT 1;

question: 优衣库卖出的商品件数合计是多少？
reference_sql:
SELECT SUM(fo.order_quantity) AS total_quantity
FROM fact_order fo
JOIN dim_product dp ON fo.product_id = dp.product_id
WHERE dp.brand = '优衣库';

question: 青铜会员买手机数码花了多少钱？
reference_sql: SELECT SUM(fo.order_amount) AS total_amount FROM fact_order fo JOIN dim_customer dc ON fo.customer_id = dc.customer_id JOIN dim_product dp ON fo.product_id = dp.product_id WHERE dc.member_level = '青铜' AND dp.category = '手机数码';

question: 按月统计销售额
reference_sql:
SELECT CONCAT(d.year, '-', LPAD(d.month, 2, '0')) AS `month`, SUM(f.order_amount) AS sales_amount
FROM fact_order f
JOIN dim_date d ON f.date_id = d.date_id
GROUP BY d.year, d.month
ORDER BY d.year, d.month;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT fo.order_id) AS order_count

question: 各品类各月的成交金额是多少？
reference_sql:
SELECT
  p.category AS 品类,
  CONCAT(d.year, '-', LPAD(d.month, 2, '0')) AS 年月,
  SUM(f.order_amount) AS 成交金额
FROM fact_order f
JOIN dim_product p ON f.product_id = p.product_id
JOIN dim_date d ON f.date_id = d.date_id
GROUP BY p.category, d.year, d.month
ORDER BY p.category, d.year, d.month;

【用户查询】
上海市有多少笔订单？

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT f.order_id) AS order_count
FROM fact_order f
JOIN dim_region r ON f.region_id = r.region_id
WHERE r.province = '上海市';

question: 阿迪达斯的销售额是多少？
reference_sql: SELECT SUM(fo.order_amount) AS sales_amount FROM fact_order fo JOIN dim_product dp ON fo.product_id = dp.product_id WHERE dp.brand = '阿迪达斯';
